name: @shepherdjerred/the-storm
description: Turbo shim over the Gradle build of The Storm's Paper plugin (plugin/) — scripts wrap Gradle so the workspace joins the task graph (caching + affected). Same pattern as the Go and Rust shims. tests/e2e is the TypeScript real-server harness.

scripts.test:client: mise exec -- gradle -p client test --console=plain && bun --no-install --bun vitest run tools/client --config ../../vitest.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:client
scripts.test: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin test --console=plain && bun --no-install --bun vitest --config ../../vitest.config.ts run tests/rcon.test.ts && bun run test:client && bun run test:learning
scripts.test:smoke: bun --no-install --bun vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/plugin.e2e.test.ts tests/e2e/server.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:learning: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/bots/learning -p '*_test.py' && uv run --project tools/learning --locked python -m unittest discover -s tools/learning -p '*_test.py' && bun --no-install --bun vitest run tools/learning --config ../../vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint:learning: uv run --project tools/learning --locked ruff check tools/learning && uv run --project tools/learning --locked ruff format --check tools/learning
scripts.lint: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin spotlessCheck pmdMain pmdTest --console=plain && mise exec -- gradle -p client spotlessCheck pmdMain pmdTest --console=plain && bunx --no-install eslint --cache . && bun run lint:learning
scripts.typecheck: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin compileJava compileTestJava --console=plain && mise exec -- gradle -p client compileJava compileTestJava --console=plain && PATH=node_modules/@typescript/native/bin:$PATH tsc --noEmit && bun run typecheck:learning
scripts.check: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin check --console=plain && bun run check:client
